query: SELECT id AS "id!: String" FROM record_identities WHERE kind = 'roleAssignment' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.subject.kind') = 'project' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.subject.subject') = ? AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.role') = 'lead' ORDER BY json_extract(payload, '$.record.envelope.position.position.position') DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
